title: Right adjoint of quasi-coherent pushforward for qcqs algebraic spaces
statement: Work in the fixed universes [def-weil-size-convention]. Use schemes [def-pc-scheme], algebraic spaces and their small etale structure sheaves [def-trf-algebraic-space], module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and the unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Write $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Z)$ for objects with quasi-coherent cohomology [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module]. Use the canonical small etale module functors [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors]. Derived direct image is computed by K-injective resolutions, and derived tensor pullback by K-flat resolutions. Let $S$ be a scheme and $f:X\to Y$ a morphism of quasi-compact quasi-separated algebraic spaces over $S$. Then $Rf_*$ takes $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ to $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Y)$ and admits a right adjoint $a_f$. Its adjunction bijection sends $u:E\to a_f(F)$ to $\epsilon_{f,F}\circ Rf_*u$, where $\epsilon_f:Rf_*a_f\to\mathrm{id}$ is the counit. No Noetherian, smoothness or properness hypothesis is required.

source.place: Tag 0E55, lemma-twisted-inverse-image; section-trace defines the counit trace.

proof.text: By [lem-sfb-space-qcqs-permanence], the given $f$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Apply [lem-sfb-space-derived-pushforward-coproducts] to obtain the restriction $R:D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)\to D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Y)$ and its preservation of all small coproducts. By [lem-sfb-space-perfect-localizing-generation] applied to $X$ and $Y$, both full subcategories have these ambient coproducts and are closed under shifts and cones. They therefore inherit the distinguished triangles and triangulated structure from [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

The canonical $f_*$ is additive: its sectionwise limit construction [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors] respects sums of module morphisms. Module sheaves on the small etale ringed sites of $X$ and $Y$ (small by [def-weil-size-convention]) form abelian categories in which every complex has a K-injective resolution [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist], so the hypotheses of [lem-pc-right-derived-functor-triangulated] hold and the K-injective right-derived functor $Rf_*$ is triangulated by it. Since the distinguished triangles in the full quasi-coherent subcategories are inherited, and Step 1 shows that $Rf_*$ takes their objects into the target subcategory, its restriction $R$ is exact.

source.place: Tag 0E55, lemma-twisted-inverse-image, verification that the restricted derived functor is exact; the general K-injective triangulation theorem.

proof.text: Choose the compact perfect generator $P$ supplied by [lem-sfb-space-compact-perfect-generator]. Its singleton family generates the source: if $E\not\simeq0$, some $\operatorname{Hom}(P[n],E)$ is nonzero, equivalently some $\operatorname{Hom}(P,E[-n])$ is nonzero. Thus the source is compactly generated in [def-pc-compactly-generated]. Together with Steps 1 and 2 these are exactly the hypotheses of [lem-pc-brown-representability-right-adjoint]. It supplies a right adjoint $a_f$ to $R=Rf_*$.

source.place: Tag 0E55, lemma-twisted-inverse-image, proof, using Tags 09IY, 09M8 and 0A8G.

proof.text: Let $\alpha_{E,F}:\operatorname{Hom}(E,a_fF)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}(Rf_*E,F)$ be this adjunction, and set $\epsilon_{f,F}=\alpha_{a_fF,F}(\mathrm{id}_{a_fF})$. Naturality of $\alpha$ in $E$, applied to $u:E\to a_fF$, gives $\alpha_{E,F}(u)=\alpha_{a_fF,F}(\mathrm{id})\circ Rf_*u=\epsilon_{f,F}\circ Rf_*u$. Naturality in $F$ gives the counit transformation $Rf_*a_f\to\mathrm{id}$. This is precisely the asserted bijection. Every hypothesis used above was qcqs; none imposes Noetherianity, smoothness or properness.

source.place: section-trace, definition of the trace as the adjunction counit and its Hom formula.
